definition.title: Cache hits by layer vs misses
definition._why: `cache.hit` carries a `layer` tag (memory / redis); `cache.miss` at client.ts:130 carries NO tags at all, so it is deliberately NOT grouped — `by {layer}` on it would render one line called (empty) and read as a broken split.

definition.title: Broker sync records by broker
definition._why: Stands in for the p95 duration widget the plan asked for. Not the same measurement — it is throughput, not latency — but it is the one that has points, and a failure count with no volume beside it cannot tell a healthy quiet Sunday from a sync that stopped running.

definition.title: Post-sync pairing failures
definition._why: Stands in for pairing.trades_processed. Pairing runs in-process after a sync and its failure is swallowed on purpose (the data sync has already succeeded), so this counter is the only place that failure is visible.

definition.title: Feed-archive replay degraded
definition._why: QA replays prod's archived exchange bytes and falls back to scraping NSE/BSE on a miss — a SOFT failure by design, so the only way to see a mirror that has stopped landing before the consumer runs is this counter.
